observations: Black game console with a matte finish.
Two wireless controllers in retail boxes.
The boxes are labeled 'Wireless Controller' and 'X6'.
A power cable with a UK-style plug is visible.
The console is resting on a cardboard box.
A watermark 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: The console is visible in photo 0, but the brand and model are not legible on the front or any label in the photo.
The exterior of the console appears clean in photo 0, but internal condition and ports are not shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be broken or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and launched.

risks.risk: The controllers may be generic or third-party despite the boxes.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the controllers showing the model number.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powered on and navigating the dashboard.
Video of a game disc being read and launched.
Photo of the back of the controllers to confirm they are original Sony X6 models.
Photo of the console's model number sticker (usually on the bottom or back).
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
